text: One colour scheme for both clients: flat white/black background, accent #5A97FF with highlighted text #126BFF, held in one configurable place; no wallpaper colours on Android

On main (e009abfa), full gate green incl. the new web parity test reading BrandColors.kt: accent #5A97FF, highlighted text #126BFF/#5A97FF, flat #FFFFFF/#000000 backgrounds, neutral greys, no surface tint, dynamic colour removed; the web tokens in index.css with --color-accent-strong; Android BrandColors.kt with Theme.kt built from it. Noted, not changed: white on the accent is 2.9:1 (buttons); the maintainer may prefer #126BFF as the filled-button colour in light mode.
